headword: {案|あん}ずるより{産|う}むが{易|やす}し
reading: あんずるよりうむがやすし
gloss: doing is easier than worrying about it

definitions.gloss: doing it is easier than worrying about it; things turn out easier than feared
definitions.explanation: A proverb, literally "giving birth is easier than fretting about it": something one dreads usually proves easier once one actually does it. Used to encourage someone, or to look back on a worry that turned out to be unfounded.

examples.japanese: {案|あん}ずるより{産|う}むが{易|やす}しだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's easier to just do it than to worry about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{案|あん}ずるより{産|う}むが{易|やす}しだった。
examples.english: The interview was easier than I had feared.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人旅|ひとりたび}→一人旅：18216_hitoritabi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{案|あん}ずるより{産|う}むが{易|やす}しで、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: I was nervous about my first trip alone, but it was easier than I'd feared and a lot of fun.

notes:
USAGE:
- Used as a noun phrase with だ / で: {案|あん}ずるより{産|う}むが{易|やす}しだった (it was easier than I'd feared). ⟦{案|あん}ずる→案ずる：13144_anzuru⟧ is a written word for ⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧.
